title: Supreme Court Judges Leave Pension and Privileges Amendment Order 2010

sections.shortTitle: Supreme Court Judges Leave Pension and Privileges Amendment Order 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SUPREME COURT JUDGES (LEAVE, PENSION AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER,
2010
SUPREME COURT JUDGES (LEAVE, PENSION AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER,
2011
An Order further to amend the
Supreme Court Judges
(Leave, Pension and Privileges)
Order, 1997
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I,
25th January, 2011]
No. F.2(2)/2011-Pub,
dated 25-1-2011. --The following President's Order promulgated by the President
is hereby published for general
information:--
Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and
Privileges) Order, 1997 (P.O. No.2 of 1997), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
Now, therefore, in
exercise of the powers conferred by the Fifth Schedule to the Constitution of
the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make the
following Order:--
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Order
may be called the Supreme Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges)
(Amendment) Order, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the 1st
days of July, 2010.
